method: Complete 0.5-second visual review, 0.125-second review at 5004-5010 and 0.25-second review at 5026-5040; additional 480p 0.25-second reference review at 5005-5010, 5027-5031 and 5037-5040 resolves rebound/pass ambiguities. Assistant-reviewed, not independently verified by a human coach.
definition: Visible live-ball field-goal attempts including blocked attempts; free throws excluded. Duration includes ordinary dead balls and inbound preparation, not exclusively live-ball time.
split: expansion frozen before any algorithm run on this time range; same game as previous splits, NOT a new-game holdout

shots.note: 黑衣右篮近筐接球后起跳投射，球离手上行。

reviewedNegatives.note: 外围争抢传球、出界后停表和发球准备。
球由首次出手在篮圈附近弹起后下落，白衣跳起摘下篮板并收球；黑衣未再次朝篮筐投射。
白衣连续向低位和外围传球，低位球员持球转身再分球，无投篮释放。
白衣外围持球分球，低位上举保持控球，随后传出；不是一次投篮。
